products.title: Neon Stack
products.tagline: Stack it perfect. Stack it high.
products.summary: A one-tap isometric stacking game with a neon synthwave look, perfect-drop combos, a growing tower and a cinematic zoom-out finale.
products.controls: Tap, click or press Space to drop the block.
features: One-tap gameplay that anyone understands in 2 seconds
Isometric 2.5D rendering with neon edges and a synthwave grid
Perfect-drop combos, block regrow and rising musical chimes
Cinematic camera zoom-out on game over
Built-in demo bot for trailers and an animated title screen
Everything reskinnable from one commented config file

products.title: Cosmic Merge
products.summary: A drop-and-merge physics puzzle in the genre that took over app stores and streams: combine cute planets into bigger ones, all the way to a black hole.
products.controls: Move to aim, tap or click to drop. Arrow keys + Space on keyboard.
features: Stable custom circle physics that settles 60+ bodies smoothly
11 hand-drawn procedural planets with cute animated faces
Combo chains, evolution chain and first-discovery banners
Aim guide, next preview and a fair overflow rule
Swap planets for fruit, candy or your brand's products
Built-in demo bot for trailers and an animated title screen

products.title: Brick Blitz
products.tagline: Smash. Power up. Blitz through 12 levels.
products.summary: A neon brick-breaker with 12 handcrafted levels, 8 power-ups, explosive chain reactions, level select and progress saving.
products.controls: Move the mouse or drag to steer, tap or press Space to launch.
features: 12 handcrafted levels in a plain-text level format you can edit
8 power-ups: multi-ball, laser, fireball, catch, wide, slow and more
Explosive bricks with chain reactions, steel bricks, combos
Level select with saved progress and an endless loop mode
Tunnel-proof sub-stepped ball physics
Built-in demo bot for trailers and an animated title screen

products.title: Promo Arcade
products.tagline: Branded mini-games that turn visitors into customers.
products.summary: Three brandable mini-games (Catch Rush, Memory Match and Spin & Win) for shops, cafés, events and campaigns: rewards, coupon codes, lead capture and a one-file rebrand.
products.controls: Tap or click. Drag or use arrow keys in Catch Rush.
features: 3 games in one kit: Catch Rush, Memory Match, Spin & Win
Rebrand everything (logo, colours, products, prizes) in one file
Coupon-code rewards by score, weighted prize wheel odds
Optional lead-capture form that posts to any webhook
Spins-per-day limit, share buttons, analytics hooks
Mobile-first design for QR codes, social links and kiosks

services.title: Branded mini-game for your business
services.summary: A catch game, memory game or prize wheel in your logo, colours and products, with coupon rewards and optional lead capture. Share it by link, QR code or on your website.

services.title: Custom HTML5 game
services.summary: A reskin of one of our games in your theme, or an original arcade or puzzle game built around your idea. Ready for your website, itch.io or game portals.

services.title: Game and web fixes
services.summary: Bugs, mobile layout problems, slow performance, or an ad SDK to integrate in your HTML5 game or JavaScript site. Clear fixed price before any work starts.
